projects.title: Bharathi Thervu Kalam
projects.description: A personal/professional landing website showcasing Bharathi’s vision, skills, and online presence with a modern, responsive design.

caseStudy.problem: Needed an online presence to introduce personal brand, highlight professional skills, and connect with visitors easily.
caseStudy.solution: Built a lightweight and responsive personal site using modern React/Next.js stack deployed on Vercel, optimized for SEO and performance.
caseStudy.outcome: Enhanced online identity with a fast-loading, mobile-friendly site that serves as a professional landing page.

projects.title: Soolya Service Hub Platform
projects.description: A centralized service marketplace platform that connects customers with verified service providers through a modern, scalable web application.

caseStudy.problem: The client needed a unified platform where users could discover, book, and manage multiple local services with real-time availability and secure authentication.
caseStudy.solution: Designed and developed a full-stack service hub using React for the frontend and Node.js with MongoDB for the backend. Implemented role-based access for customers and service providers, along with optimized API responses.
caseStudy.outcome: Improved user onboarding speed by 50%, reduced service booking friction, and achieved high platform stability with 99.9% uptime.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A complete e-commerce solution with inventory management, payment processing, and analytics dashboard.

caseStudy.problem: Client needed a scalable e-commerce platform to handle 10,000+ daily orders with real-time inventory sync.
caseStudy.solution: Built a microservices architecture with React frontend, Node.js backend, and PostgreSQL database. Implemented Redis caching for product listings.
caseStudy.outcome: Reduced page load time by 60%, increased conversion rate by 45%, and achieved 99.9% uptime during peak sales.

projects.title: Sanctus Vision Portal
projects.description: A modern vision platform providing users with intuitive access to services and tools through a secure, responsive web interface.

caseStudy.problem: Users needed a centralized portal with secure access to vision-related resources and tools with fast load and modern UI.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a scalable web portal using Next.js and React with responsive design and optimized performance, deployed on Vercel for global access.
caseStudy.outcome: Delivered a fast, responsive portal that improves user engagement and provides seamless access across all devices.
